title: Refactor visual tokens for responsive and elevation consistency
creator: Aisha Patel
title_detail: Consolidate and rename color, type, spacing, radius, and shadow tokens so components behave predictably across breakpoints and themes
description: Goal: Replace the ad-hoc token set with a coherent, semantic token system that supports responsive typography, a consistent spacing rhythm, unified corner radii, and three elevation layers for both light and dark themes. This reduces per-component overrides, improves accessibility, and makes runtime theming deterministic for Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments. Scope: color palette ramps (semantic + neutrals), typography scale (6 tiers with responsive variants), spacing (4px base with 1/2/1.5 multipliers for fine control), radius tokens for surfaces and controls, and shadow/elevation tokens (elevation-1/2/3 with dark-mode alternatives). Deliverables: Figma spec pages, token JSON schema, migration guide for engineers, automated contrast report, and updated components for Button, Table, Card, and Chart legend tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec published in Figma with token table and usage examples
Token JSON exported and validated against the token schema (no nested objects in sheet)
Engineers have migration guide and list of renamed tokens with mapping
Button, Table, Card, and Chart components updated to use new tokens in the component library PRs
Automated color contrast checks pass for primary text/interactive states (WCAG AA minimum)
Shadow/elevation visual QA across light and dark themes completed and screenshots attached

risks_and_tradeoffs: Large token rename increases churn in repos — mitigation: provide automated codemods and clear rename map
Tighter contrast targets may reduce vibrancy of accent colors — tradeoff accepted for accessibility and enterprise compliance
Shadow/elevation choices may look different across GPU renderers and browsers — mitigation: visual QA across Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox and fallbacks using overlay alpha for dark mode
qa_notes: Run visual diff tests for Button, Table, Card, Chart legend at 3 breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1440px)
Confirm token fallbacks when runtime provides only legacy token names
Validate dark-mode elevation with 10 users in internal playtest and capture subjective feedback
Ensure charts maintain minimum contrast for legends and axis labels at small sizes
